bowl_allowance.description: Per-shape l bowl allowance refined with l/I blurred-ink interaction and mid-xheight gaps; preserve vertical pairs, ll, and fl ligatures.

rhythm_refinement.description: Reduce excessive upright lo/ly spacing; selective related-shape and italic corrections. Preserve existing a/w/y preferences.
rhythm_refinement.method: Compare lX/IX at three Gaussian radii and mid-xheight contour gaps against Fira Sans 4.301; use conservative changes where the metrics disagree.

punctuation_allowance.description: Fira Sans positive l/punctuation kerning scaled to 2000 UPM, with Black at 3x its original allowance and Heavy halfway between Bold and Black. Existing letter kerning is retained; fl ligatures are excluded.
punctuation_allowance.heavy_rule: Halfway between the Bold and Black allowances.
